outcome: A customer-supplied webhook endpoint is checked before the product makes requests to it.

acceptance_criteria.text: An ordinary public https endpoint is accepted.

expected_verification.assertion: a public https URL is deliverable

acceptance_criteria.text: An endpoint that resolves to a private, loopback or link-local address is refused, including by numeric or alternate spelling.

expected_verification.assertion: a URL for 169.254.169.254 and one for 10.0.0.5 are both refused

data_impact: None directly. The product makes outbound requests to the address.
security_impact: Server-side request forgery: a customer chooses an address inside the product's own network, including cloud instance metadata.
rollback: git revert removes the check entirely.
